Recovery · Finland

Ukrainian UAV found in Iitti on 11 April

11 April 2026 · Iitti · Ukrainian UAV recovery

Confirmed Ukrainian-origin UAV recovery and unauthorized entry

Finnish investigators identified the UAV found in Iitti on 11 April 2026 as the fourth recovered spring drone. They established Ukrainian origin and unauthorized entry, with jamming and weather causing the spring diversions rather than Finland being the intended target.

This is one recovery record, separate from the March finds. The discovery date is not an established flight or crash date; the exact site and individual disposal method remain unresolved.
